name: Single stroke roll
pattern: R L R L R L R L
about: Alternating single strokes.

name: Single stroke four
pattern: R L R L:3 R L R L:3
about: Three quick strokes and one on the second half of the beat, twice.

name: Single stroke seven
pattern: R L R L R L R:6
about: Six quick strokes in a beat, then a seventh on the next.

name: Multiple bounce roll
about: A closed (buzz) roll: one held note. It can only be listened to, not graded stroke by stroke.

name: Triple stroke roll
pattern: R R R L L L R R R L L L
about: Three strokes with each hand in turn.

name: Double stroke open roll
pattern: R R L L R R L L
about: Double strokes: two with each hand.

name: Five stroke roll
pattern: R R L L R>
about: Two diddles and an accent.

name: Six stroke roll
pattern: R> L L R R L>
about: An accent, two diddles, an accent.

name: Seven stroke roll
pattern: R R L L R R L>
about: Three diddles and an accent.

name: Nine stroke roll
pattern: R R L L R R L L R>
about: Four diddles and an accent.

name: Ten stroke roll
pattern: R R L L R R L L R> L>
about: Four diddles and two accents.

name: Eleven stroke roll
pattern: R R L L R R L L R R L>
about: Five diddles and an accent.

name: Thirteen stroke roll
pattern: R R L L R R L L R R L L R>
about: Six diddles and an accent.

name: Fifteen stroke roll
pattern: R R L L R R L L R R L L R R L>
about: Seven diddles and an accent.

name: Seventeen stroke roll
pattern: R R L L R R L L R R L L R R L L R>
about: Eight diddles and an accent.

name: Single paradiddle
pattern: R> L R R L> R L L
about: Two singles and a diddle; the accent starts each group.

name: Double paradiddle
pattern: R> L R L R R L> R L R L L
about: Four singles and a diddle.

name: Triple paradiddle
pattern: R> L R L R L R R L> R L R L R L L
about: Six singles and a diddle.

name: Single paradiddle-diddle
pattern: R> L R R L L R> L R R L L
about: Two singles and two diddles.

name: Flam
pattern: lR>:4 rL>:4
about: A soft grace note just before a main stroke with the other hand.

name: Flam accent
pattern: lR> L R rL> R L
about: A flam and two taps, in threes.

name: Flam tap
pattern: lR> R rL> L lR> R rL> L
about: A flam on the first stroke of each diddle.

name: Flamacue
pattern: lR L> R L lR:4
about: A flam, an accented tap, two taps, and a flam on the next beat.

name: Flam paradiddle
pattern: lR> L R R rL> R L L
about: A paradiddle with a flam on the first stroke.

name: Single flammed mill
pattern: lR> R L R rL> L R L
about: An inverted paradiddle with a flam on the first stroke.

name: Flam paradiddle-diddle
pattern: lR> L R R L L rL> R L L R R
about: A paradiddle-diddle with a flam on the first stroke.

name: Pataflafla
pattern: lR> L R rL> lR> L R rL>
about: Four strokes with a flam on the first and the last.

name: Swiss army triplet
pattern: lR> R L lR> R L
about: A flam and two taps as a triplet.

name: Inverted flam tap
pattern: lR> L rL> R lR> L rL> R
about: A flam on the second stroke of each diddle.

name: Flam drag
pattern: lR>:2 L L R:2 rL>:2 R R L:2
about: A flam, a drag (a double stroke) and a tap.

name: Drag
pattern: llR:4 rrL:4
about: Two soft grace notes before a main stroke with the other hand.

name: Single drag tap
pattern: llR L> rrL R>
about: A drag, then an accented tap with the other hand.

name: Double drag tap
pattern: llR llR L> rrL rrL R>
about: Two drags, then an accented tap.

name: Lesson 25
pattern: llR L R>:2 llR L R>:2
about: A drag, a tap and an accented tap, in threes.

name: Single dragadiddle
about: A paradiddle whose first stroke is a diddle.

name: Drag paradiddle #1
pattern: R>:2 llR L R R L>:2 rrL R L L
about: An accented stroke, then a paradiddle with a drag on its first stroke.

name: Drag paradiddle #2
pattern: R>:2 llR:2 llR L R R L>:2 rrL:2 rrL R L L
about: An accented stroke, a drag, then a paradiddle with a drag on its first stroke.

name: Single ratamacue
pattern: llR L R L>:3 rrL R L R>:3
about: A drag, two taps and an accented tap.

name: Double ratamacue
pattern: llR:3 llR L R L>:3 rrL:3 rrL R L R>:3
about: A drag, then a single ratamacue.

name: Triple ratamacue
pattern: llR:3 llR:3 llR L R L>:3 rrL:3 rrL:3 rrL R L R>:3
about: Two drags, then a single ratamacue.
